_rhythm: slots copied from the reference cut list (11.4s total)
style_suffix: Soft flat diffused daylight, no hard shadows. The wolf is carved ENTIRELY from the melon's own layers: dark green rind for the nose and dark markings, pale cream-white carved rind as the fur, each tuft a separate knife cut with its own cast shadow. Matte natural texture, no glow, no airbrush. Subtle handheld micro-movement, shallow focus. Photorealistic, ultra-detailed. Nothing else in the frame changes.

shots.name: 01_wide_open
shots.prompt: The hands holding the carved watermelon turn it very slightly toward the camera and steady it; a knife tip touches the rind at the edge of the carving.

shots.name: 02_brow
shots.prompt: A knife tip etches two or three short fur lines into the pale carved rind above the eye; a sliver of rind lifts away.

shots.name: 03_eyes
shots.prompt: A knife tip traces the carved edge beside the eye, deepening one cut; a tiny pale shaving curls off and falls.

shots.name: 04_fur
shots.prompt: The blade shaves along the fur tufts and several thin pale shavings curl off the knife and fall away out of frame.

shots.name: 05_mouth
shots.prompt: The knife tip works at the lip beside a carved fang; the red flesh inside the open mouth glistens wet. The mouth stays exactly the same shape.

shots.name: 06_fangs
shots.prompt: A knife tip cleans the edge of one carved fang and a small crumb of rind drops away; juice glistens on the blade.

shots.name: 07_wipe
shots.prompt: The cloth in the hand wipes once across the carved surface, leaving it clean and glossy, then lifts away.

shots.name: 08_hero
shots.prompt: The finished carved watermelon rests still, rotating a few degrees very slowly on the plain surface for the final reveal.
